Meze

One guest lists salad with tzatziki and tahini, eggs with zucchini, sausage, halloumi, cheese with honey, liver with onions, meatballs, sieftalia, souvlaki, ribs and chicken.

Home cooking

Guests describe the food as home-cooked and freshly made. 5 Google reviews mention traditional food.

In the mountains

In Kouka near Pera Pedi. One guest calls it a lovely restaurant in the mountains, perfect for a quiet meal.

In Kouka
